text: The added checkConfig comment groups the protocol select with controls that should be hidden, but the next assertion explicitly checks that select is visible. Separate assertions correctly describe the security and port controls as hidden. The fixed accepted test retains the same contradiction. This is a scoped comment-accuracy finding; the assertion already has a nonempty expected-result message, and no runtime visibility failure is inferred.
